$(a - I\omega)(a + I\omega) = a^2 + a \cdot I\omega - I\omega \cdot a - (I\omega)^2$

$= a^2 + I a\omega - I a\omega - I^2\omega^2$

$= a^2 - I^2\omega^2$

Since $I^2 = -1$:
$= a^2 - (-1)\omega^2$

$= a^2 + \omega^2$
